ballot.title: California 2024 certified vote results
ballot.body: 2024 California statewide certified results: Proposition 2 approved; Proposition 3 approved. This results table does not explain each measure. PDF text extracted from a synthetic evaluation copy.

ballot.title: California Proposition 2 title and summary
ballot.body: Proposition 2 authorizes $10 billion in general obligation bonds for K–12 public school and community college facilities. Approved in November 2024.

ballot.title: California Proposition 3 title and summary
ballot.snippet: Fundamental right to marry; removes man-and-woman language.
ballot.body: Proposition 3 amends the California Constitution to recognize a fundamental right to marry and removes language defining marriage as between a man and a woman. Approved in November 2024. It does not by itself establish a changed eligibility rule.

ballot.title: Oregon 2025 law foreword
ballot.snippet: Foreword to Oregon laws, not Measure 118 result.
ballot.body: Foreword to the Oregon laws. This document is not a certified Measure 118 outcome or detailed measure explanation.

ballot.title: Oregon 2024 certified ballot statement
ballot.body: Oregon Measure 118 failed in November 2024. The proposal would have raised the highest corporate minimum taxes and distributed revenue to eligible individuals as rebates. Because it failed, these changes did not take effect.
